beats.headline: Five hours of building
beats.text: Building the launcher takes about five hours, and Carl sprays Mother of All Bombs on its side with Agatha's paint. Brandon points out that MOAB stands for Massive Ordnance Air Blast, and that a mother of all bombs means one giant bomb: call it the Bomb Chicken or something. Too late, says Carl. While they build, he finds that in a safe room every stick of dynamite reads Inert While in Safe Room. He doesn't expect it to kill the level-93 thing outside. The babies will slow it down, though.

beats.headline: The first baby rolls
beats.text: With its sidecar the chopper won't fit through the door, so a new bike trailer carries the launcher and a tall seat for Donut behind it, facing backward like a tailgunner. The ramp is a pair of spare chopper wheel wells with half-pipe channels and wheelchair coasters at its foot. Each baby is snowboard-sized, weighted like a pinewood derby car, on free-weight wheels. Donut pulls the first, Baby Uno, onto the platform: three boom jugs, goblin oil, gunpowder and the last of Carl's hobgoblin pus. She nudges it, and it rolls away down the hall behind them, straight, without rearing up.

beats.headline: Boom babies and shredders
beats.text: Carl presses the detonator, and during its five-second delay Donut pulls the black lever to drop Imani's weighted chain through a chamber. Baby Uno blows half a second late, in the elemental's back. Then the boom babies go, one after another, flipping into the grubs and filling the hallway with blue flame, while the chain snares the monster for a moment; the few that do not light themselves she hits with a low-powered magic missile. The elemental's spell flings the back of the trailer up, but they are too far away. Around the last corner she drops shredders, gunpowder and shrapnel on long wicks, which burst the pupae and give the monster hornet creatures to stop and kill.

beats.headline: Over the edge
beats.text: The chopper's boiler is about to breach, fifteen seconds, and Carl can't remember which valve to turn, so he speeds up. In the stairwell chamber Donut pulls the red lever and the second chamber sprays champagne-coloured oil across the floor. Both of them jump. The chopper keeps going, trailer and launcher with it, spilling oil, and plummets into the stairwell hole. It crunches, followed by a relatively small explosion. At the edge Carl sets down one of the oh shit babies, two boom jars, gunpowder and a ring of dynamite, as the elemental comes out of the smoke.
